headline: Graduate Software Engineer — AI Systems & Automation
summary: Pasan focuses on backend engineering, distributed systems, and AI automation. His work combines software architecture fundamentals with modern tooling so solutions are easier to scale, operate, and extend.
highlights: Engineers backend APIs in Python and C++ using REST, HTTP, and gRPC service patterns.
Designs event-driven systems with Kafka and RabbitMQ to separate services and improve resilience.
Builds AI automation workflows with LangGraph, LangChain, and OpenRouter-based LLM integrations.
Applies secure coding practices with validation, guardrails, and threat-aware design.
Uses Docker and GitHub Actions to improve release consistency and development velocity.
Translates product requirements into maintainable code, clear documentation, and testable flows.
